entries.en: Sweet Jesus... You hear that? Do ya hear what they're playin'?
That's what peeps with bad taste always say.
entries.ro: Asta zic mereu cei cu gusturi proaste.

entries.en: Don't know what he did to deserve what's comin', but his music taste is reason enough to drop him.
entries.ro: Habar n-am ce-a făcut ca să merite ce-i vine, dar gusturile lui muzicale sunt motiv suficient să-l eliminăm.
